# ClickOne AI

> The AI front office for HVAC, plumbing, roofing and remodeling contractors in Georgia and Florida. ClickOne answers, follows up and books leads 24/7 in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Built and run for you.

ClickOne AI sells two plans. Every client gets ongoing maintenance, optimization and training by the ClickOne team.

- Recover ($497/month, $997 setup, set up in 7 days): automatic text back for missed calls, instant replies to web, Google and Facebook forms, booking, confirmations and reminders, no-show and estimate follow-up, Google review requests and a monthly report. Text messages switch on once US carriers approve the business number (A2P 10DLC), which usually takes 10+ business days.
- Front Office ($997/month, $1,497 setup, AI voice live in 7 days): everything in Recover plus AI voice answering 24/7 in English, Spanish and Portuguese, AI replies to Google reviews, one reactivation campaign per quarter and 500 voice minutes a month (then $0.25 per minute).

Works with Jobber, Housecall Pro and QuickBooks. Connects to ServiceTitan, JobNimbus, Roofr and more through automation. The AI always says it is an AI, and a person is one step away.
